content.text: {"id": "mm5622a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Among the rail transport events, 78 (7.4%) involved a chemical release"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Injuries were reported from 11 (14.1%) of the 78 rail events; a total of 144 persons were injured"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "approximately 81% of hazardous-substance releases from rail events occurred in areas with residences within 0.25 mile"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Of the 210 total injuries sustained by the 144 persons, the most commonly reported were respiratory irritation (104 [49.5%])"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The most common primary contributing factor in these 78 events was equipment failure (49 events [62.8%])"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "rail events constitute only 2% of total hazardous-substance releases in HSEES"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "this report summarizes all rail events reported to HSEES from 17 state health departments"}]}, {"v": "case report/series", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The following four event reports were selected to highlight the public health consequences"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Analysis of HSEES data was limited to the 78 rail events in which chemicals were released"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the area of impact (i.e., the area where the plume extended) was > 200 feet from the point of release"}], "confidence": "medium", "uncertain_fields": ["data_focus", "outcome_types", "analytic_depth"]}
